''This article is about the Relics based on G1 Megatron. You may be looking for the other [[Megatron Relic]].''
[[File:Megatron Relic G1 portrait.png|thumb|220x220px]]
The '''Megatron Relic'''s are earned by completing the [[I Still Function]] Spotlight Missions.

== Description ==
''A symbol of victory over [[Megatron]], adorned with the terrifying visage of the Decepticon Leader himself. Awarded for mastery of the G1 Megatron Special Mission.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* (Tier 1): +2% Attack in Arenas.
* Bronze: +3%
* Silver: +4%
* Gold: +5%
